summary: Full frontend regression on the new Home changes (card takes vertical space, StoryInfoGrid inline moved below the card as deck-badges/home-story-meta, DeckProgress asymmetric indicator, morph transition). All 7 scenarios from the review request PASS. Onboarding via 'Continue as guest' + 6 topic chips + onboarding-continue reaches Home. On Home the active card (deck-layer-active) is tall (box y=62 h=455 at 390x844), deck-badges is placed BELOW the card (y=527 h=54) INSIDE home-story-deck and contains home-story-meta (StoryInfoGrid inline) showing kind / category / minutes matching the active title (e.g. 'MINI LESSON · TECHNOLOGY · 6 min' with title 'Spotting a deepfake…'). DeckProgress renders discover-deck-dots container, with NO discover-deck-dot-0 at cursor 0, and both discover-deck-dot-active and discover-deck-continue present; the '1 / N' text is NOT visible anywhere (only accessibilityLabel). After 3 left swipes on discover-swipe-area, discover-deck-dot-0/1/2 all appear, meta text changes (e.g. 'CURIOSITY · SCIENCE · 4 min') and active title changes accordingly; one right swipe removes the last past dot (dot-2), confirming symmetric growth/shrink. Tap on active card opens '/deep-dive/<id>?morph=1&rect=...' with cover, title and info sheet; no console errors; back button returns to Home with card, deck-badges and indicator all visible. Regression: home-category-list, tab-explore, tab-saved, tab-profile, tab-home all navigate correctly; /premium opens (paywall-hero) and paywall-close returns to Home. At 360x740 viewport the deck-badges box sits at y=431 h=54 and discover-deck-dots at y=485 h=20 → both fully within the viewport, nothing clipped. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Console noise identical to iteration_1 (textShadow* deprecation, props.pointerEvents deprecation, Reanimated easing on web) — cosmetic, non-blocking, already flagged.

issues: Repeating web console warnings: 'textShadow*' props deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated, Reanimated easing not supported on web (uses linear). Same as iteration_1, non-blocking.

action_items: No new action items from this iteration. All 7 requested feature checks passed. Optional/carried-over items from iteration_1 are still valid (premium.tsx onActivate→goBack, category-tile-effects accessibilityLabel placement, deprecated textShadow*/pointerEvents style props).
critical_code_review_comments: home-story-deck.tsx: DECK_BELOW_CARD_H is composed from badges + progress and used by discover.tsx to derive cardHeight = deckAreaH - DECK_BELOW_CARD_H - 8 → correct, card actually fills the remaining vertical space above the categories.
deck-badges.tsx: uses withTiming(0, {duration:110}) fade-out then setShown+lift/fade-in(240) → matches the requested 110ms/240ms cross-fade timing on card change.

deck-progress.tsx: past dots use testID discover-deck-dot-<i> up to MAX_PAST=6, active dot uses discover-deck-dot-active with brand-color glow, gradient bar uses discover-deck-continue; accessibilityLabel `${cursor+1} / ${total}` is on the container only (screen reader), no visible numeric string.

story-morph.tsx: chipsFrom now uses `from.y + from.height + DECK_BADGES_GAP` and DECK_BADGES_H → the data pill starts below the card (matches new home layout) and morphs into the reader StoryInfoGrid; Home applies `away` shared value to fade badges+progress out during morph — verified visually on tap.
seed_data_creation: None. Fresh browser context; onboarding executed inline as part of the flow.

Swipe left on discover-swipe-area advances cursor; expect ~250px drag with mouse (down→move steps→up).
